recipe.name: rl2307_save_calibration
recipe.description: Archive the finished RL2307 calibration outputs to a user-specified directory.

nodes.label: inputs.archive_dir
nodes.description: Directory to archive the calibration into, a local path or a gs:// URL.

nodes.label: inputs.calibration_outputs
nodes.description: Subdirectory under the outputs folder the earlier phases wrote to. Keep it the same as in the other two phase recipes.

nodes.label: inputs.output_base
nodes.description: Calibration outputs folder to read unset inputs from. Defaults to this run's own; set it to archive a run made elsewhere.

nodes.label: inputs.overwrite
nodes.description: Replace an archive already in archive_dir, clearing Standardized_Reports/ first.

nodes.label: inputs.single_channel_data
nodes.description: Phase 2's single_channel_data output. Read from the outputs folder when unset.

nodes.label: inputs.mapping_dict
nodes.description: Phase 2's mapping_dict output. Read from the outputs folder when unset.

nodes.label: inputs.provenance
nodes.description: Phase 2's provenance output. Read from the outputs folder when unset.

Write the finished calibration outputs to a directory the survey keeps.
Writes channel_mapping.yaml and calibration_provenance.yaml at the top of archive_dir, and one file per standardized channel under Standardized_Reports/ - the same files a local run writes to single_channel_calibration_files/. The channel files are named by each channel's calibration file key, which is what the mapping refers to, so the archive resolves against itself.
Everything is rendered from the data the standardization and mapping steps return, so a caller that never sees the run's outputs folder can archive what those steps handed it. Omit an input and it is read from the outputs folder of the run in progress instead, which is how a local run archives with nothing but a directory.
archive_dir may be a remote fsspec URL, which is the point for a client whose run directory disappears when the container does.
Mark it regenerate: always in a recipe. Its product is files outside the run's outputs directory, where the executor cannot verify them, so a cache hit would return the paths without writing anything.

inputs.name: single_channel_data
inputs.description: The standardized channels, from the standardization step's single_channel_data output. Read from single_channel_calibration_files/ under output_base when omitted.

inputs.name: mapping_dict
inputs.description: Each raw file's channels mapped to their calibration key, from build_calibration_mapping. Read from mapping_files/channel_mapping.yaml under output_base when omitted. An empty mapping is an error: that is what the mapping step returns while conflicts are unresolved, and an archive that looks complete and is not is worse than a failed run.

inputs.name: provenance
inputs.description: The provenance report from build_calibration_mapping. Read from mapping_files/calibration_provenance.yaml under output_base when omitted.

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Directory to write the archive into. May be a local path or a remote fsspec URL (e.g. gs://bucket/surveys/RL2307/calibration). Not fingerprinted: it is where this step writes, not something it reads.

params.name: output_base
params.description: Calibration outputs folder to read anything omitted from. Defaults to the folder the run in progress is writing, resolved the way initial_setup resolves it, so a local run after the mapping phase finds the files it just wrote.

params.name: calibration_outputs
params.description: Subdirectory name under the run's outputs folder, used only to build the default output_base. Match the value the earlier phases ran with.

params.name: overwrite
params.description: Replace an archive already in archive_dir. Off by default: an archive directory is written once and kept, so a non-empty destination stops the run rather than overwriting it. When on, Standardized_Reports/ is cleared first, so a channel dropped during review leaves no orphan file behind.

outputs.name: archive_dir
outputs.description: The directory the archive was written to.

outputs.name: mapping_path
outputs.description: Full path of the archived channel_mapping.yaml.

outputs.name: provenance_path
outputs.description: Full path of the archived calibration_provenance.yaml.

outputs.name: reports_dir
outputs.description: The Standardized_Reports folder holding the channel files.

outputs.name: channel_count
outputs.description: How many channel files were written.

outputs.name: files_written
outputs.description: Every path written, in write order, so a caller can report the archive without listing the destination.
